set.body:
Introduce the semantic algebra over the existing linalg operator substrate.

Acceptance:
- Stable SpaceId remains the serialized identity; a scoped SpaceRef or registry provides path-dependent or phantom Scala evidence without equating JVM object identity with semantic identity.
- Add primal and dual coordinate markers and a directed Lin or equivalent wrapper over linalg.LinearMap.
- Add a typed Table with orientation C* to O and lawful adjoint and composition.
- Distinguish structural symmetric forms, PSD semimetrics, SPD metrics, cometrics, penalties, kernels, covariance, and precision by nominal constructors and runtime role descriptors.
- Store symmetry, PSD, SPD, rank, orthogonality, and convergence certificates with tolerance, norm, method, backend, precision, regularization, and immutable value identity.
- Move trusted assumptions behind an explicit Unsafe surface and preserve assumptions in provenance.
- Add compile-time negative tests for wrong-direction composition where practicable and runtime mismatch tests for decoded existential values.
- Adapt MatrixView and linalg.LinearMap; do not introduce a parallel matrix or decomposition implementation.
- Preserve sparse, diagonal, block, and matrix-free operator representations.

Compatibility: existing MvSpace, MvMetric, and MvMap callers may use explicit adapters during migration, but a structurally checked indefinite form must not be exposed as a safe Metric.
set.title: multivar constitution: typed spaces, directed operators, forms, and certificates
